# Curiosity's Selfie on Mars

After nearly five years exploring Mars, NASA's car-sized Curiosity Rover snapped a 61-photo selfie on a Martian ridge using its hand-held camera, revealing the rover's solar-panel-covered body against the rust-colored landscape with the towering 3-mile-high Mount Sharp looming dramatically in the distance. This remarkable self-portrait—stitched together from multiple frames taken on January 23, 2018—showcases not just the rover's durability, but humanity's impressive ability to operate a sophisticated robot explorer across 140 million miles of space.
